name: ATB_AUTH_EVENT_DETAILS
description: This table contains information about authorization request data that is only relevant to a specific event in time, rather than to the whole request.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the auth bundle record.

columns.name: AUTH_EVENT_MSG_TEXT
columns.description: The free text description of the current auth status or change, but only as it pertains to a single event.
